scope: Reviewed immutable source references, not a live protocol capture or automatic ILM compatibility proof.
observations: ILM exposes Directory, newNonce, newAccount, newOrder, authorization, challenge, order, finalize and certificate resources through its ACME Profile path.
The reviewed Directory metadata sets externalAccountRequired=false. Account binding and identifier authorization remain necessary.
The reviewed ILM challenge types are dns-01 and http-01; this connector implements only the DNS-01 backend interface at this milestone.
Finalize parses the base64url external CSR and transitions the original order to processing before issuing through the RA/Authority.
The client library combines finalization, polling and download. Persistent intents and bounded HTTP/context guards wrap that combined call.
Account lookup uses onlyReturnExisting and the same supplied signing key. Unknown new-order responses cannot be safely matched by identifier lists alone.
